required_evidence: Resolve the exact published Cite Supply asset slug and persistent database identity from the live search/detail response.
Confirm the asset is published, not pending or deleted, and that its source dataset/indicator matches the article's declared input.
Record the canonical asset URL, resolved identifier, observed status, and checked timestamp.
live_asset_identity.permitted_read_path: Production search and asset detail pages over HTTPS; no direct database mutation.
fail_closed_if: asset is absent, duplicated, pending, deleted, or points to a different dataset
the live record cannot be tied to the pinned metric IDs

required_evidence: Re-read the live rights panel for the exact resolved asset.
Capture current commercial-use, modification, marketplace-rendered-embed, citation, and raw-data-redistribution states.
Re-open the source licence/evidence URL and record its current response status and checksum.
Confirm that the article's modified presentation and attribution wording fit the current source terms.
asset_level_rights.current_inventory_warning: The fact-pack rights fields are reviewed candidate evidence, not a live grant.
asset_level_rights.permitted_read_path: Live Cite Supply asset page plus the linked official Eurostat reuse notice and dataset page.
fail_closed_if: any required right is unknown, restricted, revoked, or inconsistent with the article
the source notice has an exception that has not been resolved for the proposed use

required_evidence: Re-fetch the complete scoped Eurostat API response for the approved dimensions.
Record response status, retrieval time, source update timestamp, response checksum, and status flags.
Compare the live observations with the pinned metric IDs and block release if the selected values, dimensions, or methodology changed.
For HICP, re-check the annual-average unit, EU27_2020 geography, TOTAL classification, and latest available year.
source_freshness.permitted_read_path: Official Eurostat API, dataset page, metadata, and reporting-year methodology pages over HTTPS.
fail_closed_if: the response cannot be fetched or verified
a value, dimension, status flag, classification, or methodology differs without a reviewed revision
the pinned extract is older than the release freshness policy permits

required_evidence: Use a permitted HTTPS production URL for the resolved asset or an explicitly approved staging URL; do not open local files or start a local server as a workaround.
Test smartphone 390x844, tablet 768x1024, small desktop 1280x800, and large desktop 1440x900.

Check chart/table equivalence, no horizontal overflow outside intentional table scrolling, readable labels, focus order, keyboard activation, heading order, accessible SVG names, and source-link announcements.
Record console errors, failed network requests, screenshots, and the URL plus viewport for each run.
responsive_and_assistive_qa.permitted_read_path: Browser QA skill against an approved HTTPS route after live asset identity is resolved.
fail_closed_if: there is no permitted browser URL
the chart is not understandable with the equivalent table or keyboard/screen-reader navigation
the production route differs from the reviewed private rendering

next_step.task: Independently review this inventory for completeness and reject any gate that lacks a reproducible HTTPS evidence path.
